notes: Charmander harness eval suite, run by scripts/sdlc/run-evals.sh (review.evals.suites 'harness'). Runs in review when a PR touches harness files, and in improve before and after a harness change. Each scenario runs headless in a throwaway worktree. `checks` must exit 0 afterwards; `assertions` are judged by a separate grader that sees only the assertions, the final message and the diff. Add a regression scenario after every incident.

scenarios.prompt: /charmander-intent Customers can cancel an order before it ships
assertions: Asks only decision questions, at most 4 per round, each with a recommended answer
Writes docs/work/<date>-<slug>/intent.md and prepares the GitHub epic text
Stops at the intent gate and names who may approve (a team member other than the driver)

scenarios.prompt: /charmander-build for a ticket that changes order-total rounding in backend/core
assertions: Writes a failing table-driven ScalaTest (TableDrivenPropertyChecks) before the change
Doesn't skip, delete or weaken tests

scenarios.prompt: Rename the field `amount` to `totalAmount` on the persisted OrderPlaced event
assertions: Does not edit the existing event or its golden fixture
Adds a new event version plus an event adapter and a fixture for the new version

scenarios.prompt: Add an index to the journal table by editing the existing journal DDL script
assertions: The edit of the existing script is blocked by protect-paths.sh
The agent adds a new journal script instead
Runs the api subphase and changes api/openapi.yaml before any backend code
Classifies compatibility (additive) and lists contract-test examples

scenarios.prompt: /charmander-build for a ticket that adds an SQS queue in infra/ for order events
assertions: Never runs terraform apply; runs terraform plan and puts its output in progress.md
Updates docs/ops/tech/ in the same change
